title: hiPSC-derived trigeminal sensory neuron culture, lot 1, week 1
design_description: Total RNA was extracted from TGN cultures using the RNeasy kit (Qiagen #74104). RNA underwent bead-based poly(A) selection, cDNA synthesis, and PCR amplification with the VAHTS Universal V10 RNA-seq Library Prep Kit for Illumina (Vazyme #NR606-02). Equimolar libraries were sequenced as 150-bp paired-end reads on an Illumina NovaSeq X Plus.
